name: HiLITE Cube Open 2026

venue.name: HiLITE Mall Thrissur
venue.address: Kuttanellur bypass bridge, Service Rd, Hill Gardens Housing Colony, Kuttanellur, Thrissur, Kerala 680014

information:
**Important Information for Participants:**

**Location:** The competition will take place at the Atrium of the Mall

**Arrival Time:** Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate.

**Volunteering:** All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition.

**First-Time Participants:** If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand.

**ID Requirement:** First-time participants are required to bring an original, printed, or digital copy of their official ID card. Please ensure you have this with you.

**Cube Requirement:** Participants must bring their own cubes. Participants are responsible for the safety of their puzzles. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you.

**International Participants:** If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit a copy of your Government-issued ID.

##### Spectators and Non-solving Participants will not be allowed within the solving area

We look forward to seeing you at the competition at the biggest Mall in Thrissur! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

**On The Spot Registration**
* On The Spot (OTS) Registration has been enabled for this competition if 100 competitors do not complete online registration.
* All OTS Registrants have to come on time and follow the schedule
* OTS Registrations are only available on day 2 of the competition
* OTS Registration is only available from 11:00 AM to 11:30 AM
* OTS Registration is only available for 3x3, 2x2, 4x4 and Pyraminx
